notes: SsangYong has rebranded to KGM in Australia; kgm.com.au is the current official storefront. Only two BEV nameplates exist in the AU lineup: Torres EVX (SUV, single trim) and Musso EV (ute, 3 variants). The Actyon is confirmed hybrid/petrol only in Australia - no BEV Actyon exists; excluded. Korando e-Motion was never sold in Australia; excluded. KGM AU publishes drive-away pricing only; no official MSRP-before-on-roads figure exists (before-on-road figures are CarExpert back-calculations, medium confidence). Battery capacity (80.6kWh) is never split into usable vs gross by KGM for either model. 0-100km/h acceleration is not officially published by KGM for either model; low-confidence secondary figures exist but are not corroborated and are excluded from the main fields. V2L (Sept 2026 pass): confirmed high-confidence for all Musso EV variants -- CarExpert's Australian review states the Musso EV supports V2L at up to 3.5kW (15A) via an adaptor on the charge port; added as fieldSources citation (was previously uncited despite already being recorded as true).

variants.priceBasis: Driveaway price only; KGM AU does not publish a before-on-road-costs MSRP. Homepage shows $52,990, model page shows $53,690 - small discrepancy likely due to promo timing/state

fieldSources.consumptionWhPerKm: https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2026-kgm-torres-evx-review (medium confidence, converted from brand press-release convention)
fieldSources.dcChargeKw: https://www.drive.com.au (150kW); CarExpert road-test spec table separately calculated a 164kW theoretical maximum - conflict noted, 150kW used as brand-stated figure
